item.title: Street Fighter 6 server maintenance coming tonight for new balance and feature update
item.description: <p>It's been around three months since Street Fighter 6 received a sizable update, but there's finally a new one about to drop.</p> <p>Capcom has announced that Street Fighter 6 will be undergoing server maintenance tonight, December 15, for the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/14/balance-changes-street-fighter-6/">new balance and feature update, which they've already released the patch notes for</a>.</p>

item.title: Tekken 8 Version 2.08.01 patch notes released, server maintenance underway
item.description: <p>Tekken 8 just released <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/01/miary-tekken-starter-guide/">Miary Zo as the final Season 2 character</a> earlier this month, but they're already making some more changes to the game.</p> <p>Bandai Namco has now released the Version 2.08.01 patch notes for Tekken 8 with server maintenance for the new update going on now.</p>

item.title: Humble Bundle offers multiple Mortal Kombat and Injustice titles plus many more at ridiculous price, but the deal ends in a matter of hours
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/09/netflix-warner-games-value/">Warner Bros. is going through some interesting times right now with the proposed Netflix acquisition</a> and potential Paramount hostile takeover, but now is also a great time to pick up some of their biggest games.</p> <p>Humble Bundle has brought back the WB Play the Legends Game Bundle for a ridiculously low price, however, there's only a matter of hours left to take advantage of it.</p>

item.title: 2XKO hotfix patch notes for December 16, 2025
item.description: <p>2XKO is set to finally hit its full release next month, but they're still making adjustments to the early access version of the game.</p> <p>Riot Games just released a new hotfix update for 2XKO today along with its patch notes.</p>

item.title: Arcade 1Up apparently not dead after all by finding a new home though its future remains unclear
item.description: <p>The home arcade / retro game collector communities were recently hit with the surprise <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/12/arcade1up-shutting-down/">report that Arcade 1Up had met its demise</a> though that apparently isn't quite the case after all.</p> <p>Arcade 1Up will seemingly continue to live on, but the future of the company remains a bit unclear.</p>
